name: vote-buttons
title: Vote buttons
description: Up and down arrows around a score for questions, answers and feature requests: one vote each, changeable, with the score announced.
docs: Controlled: keep value and score in state and update both in onVote once the request has succeeded. onVote receives "up", "down" or "none" (pressing the chosen arrow again clears the vote). The control moves the score by the right amount while the request is on its way, including two for a switch from down to up, and puts both back with a message in a bubble beside the control (to the right of a vertical one, to the left of a row, whichever side has room) if onVote rejects. score is written for the vote the control starts in. Set subject to name what is voted on, and allowDownvote={false} for a single arrow with a count.
